"""Verify the published readiness evidence without touching active workers."""

import json
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save

repo = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
root = repo / '.cache/quality-20261103/V151-noisy-objective-v1'
publication = repo / 'docs/results/v151-noisy-objective-preparation-v1.json'
p = read(publication)
assert len(p['copies']) == 10
for binding in p['copies'].values():
    assert ref(binding['original']['path']) == binding['original']
    assert ref(binding['public']['path']) == binding['public']
    assert Path(binding['original']['path']).read_bytes() == Path(binding['public']['path']).read_bytes()
source = read(p['sources']['path'])
assert ref(p['sources']['path']) == p['sources']
assert len(source['frozen_neural_hashes']) == 85
for path, sha in source['frozen_neural_hashes'].items():
    assert ref(path)['sha256'] == sha
    assert ref(repo / 'src/demosaic' / Path(path).name)['sha256'] == sha
assert len(source['sources']) == 12
for binding in source['sources']:
    assert ref(binding['path'])['sha256'] == binding['sha256']
    assert Path(binding['path']).read_text() == binding['text']
guard(read(root / 'plan-v1.json'))
guard(read(root / 'postprocess-plan-v1.json'))
design = read(root / 'quality-design-v1.json')
assert len(design['observations']) == 822 and len(design['endpoints']) == 6
adc = [c for c in design['observations'] if c.get('cohort') in ['adc-photo256', 'adc-sloped512']]
assert len(adc) == 24 and sum(c['kind'] == 'photo' for c in adc) == 8
assert all(c['reference_role'].startswith('Exact ') for c in adc)
for case in adc:
    assert ref(case['arrays']['path']) == case['arrays']
    assert ref(case['parent']['path']) == case['parent']
assert read(root / 'postprocess-preflight-v1.json')['planned_primary_native_figures'] == 84
assert read(root / 'checkpoint250-audit-v1.json')['finite_Adam_states'] == 36
snapshot = read(root / 'preparation-snapshot-v1.json')
assert snapshot['completed_control_trace_rows_exact_V150'] == 324
live = {}
for name, owner in snapshot['owners_confirmed_live'].items():
    process = psutil.Process(owner['pid'])
    assert abs(process.create_time() - owner['created']) < .01
    assert process.is_running() and process.status() not in ['zombie', 'dead']
    live[name] = {'owner': owner, 'status': process.status()}
trace = [json.loads(s) for s in (root / 'train-trace-v1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if s.endswith('}')]
old = read(Path(read(root / 'plan-v1.json')['previous']) / 'train-result-v1.json')['trace']
for row, previous in zip(trace, old, strict=False):
    assert row['arms']['floor16-control'] == previous['arms']['floor16-matrix']
    assert row['batch'] == previous['batch'] and row['domain'] == previous['domain']
docs = ['README.md', 'docs/index.md', 'docs/current-model.md', 'docs/research.md',
        'docs/noisy-objective-training.md', 'diary/2026-11-03-16-00-12-v151-noisy-objective-trial.md']
links = 0
for name in docs:
    path = repo / name
    for link in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)', path.read_text()):
        if '://' in link or link.startswith('#'):
            continue
        assert (path.parent / link.split('#')[0]).is_file(), (name, link)
        links += 1
save(repo / 'docs/results/v151-noisy-objective-preparation-verification-v1.json', {
    'status': 'pass-active-preparation-and-document-publication',
    'recorded_unix_UTC': time.time(), 'preparation': ref(publication),
    'byte_exact_receipt_copies': 10, 'frozen_and_current_neural_hashes_unchanged': 85,
    'source_texts_checked': 12, 'case_count': 822, 'ADC_controls': 24,
    'planned_endpoints': 6, 'planned_native_primary_figures': 84,
    'current_complete_control_trace_rows_exact_V150': len(trace),
    'document_links_checked': links, 'live_owners': live,
    'verifier': dict(ref(Path(__file__)), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'scope': 'Active preparation verification only; trained quality remains pending. Historical snapshot and checkpoint250 receipt bytes are unchanged. No neural or noise calls.'})
print(f'PASS: 10 copies, 85 neural hashes, 12 source texts, {len(trace)} exact control rows, {links} links, 3 live owners')
